Riverside — Cardiff, United Kingdom

🟢 Official crime data · South Wales Police, data.police.uk Methodology →

Higher caution advised day Higher caution advised night

In detail

South Wales Police recorded 780 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 18.9 per 1,000 residents, the 4th highest rate of Cardiff's 28 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (34), vehicle crime (34), burglary (9); the evening/night score by violent crime (65), public order (31), anti social behaviour (26). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Riverside safe?

Wandroz currently rates Riverside in Cardiff as an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Cardiff during the day and an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Cardiff at night. This rating is derived from South Wales Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Riverside safe at night?

At night, Riverside is rated as an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Cardiff. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Riverside a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Riverside's day rating (an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Cardiff) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.

Is there official crime data for Riverside?

Yes. Riverside's rating is derived from South Wales Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk, not an assessment — see the note on this page for the exact figure and the methodology page for full sourcing.
